blocks.text: Privacy and security settings help users control how their personal information is used and shared online. These settings are found in most apps, websites, and digital platforms. Students learn how to adjust them to protect personal data such as location, contacts, and browsing history. Managing privacy helps prevent misuse of information by unwanted sources or advertisers. Understanding and using these settings keeps online activities more private and secure. For example, on Instagram, users can make their account private so that only approved followers can see their posts. They can also turn off location sharing to protect their privacy and enable two-factor authentication for extra account security.
